name: from_parts
declaration: unsafe fn from_parts (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self
rules: The memory pointed to by ptr must have been allocated using the global allocator.
The alignment of T must equal the alignment with which the memory pointed to by ptr was allocated.
The size of T multiplied by capacity must equal the size in bytes with which the memory pointed to by ptr was allocated.
length must be less than or equal to capacity.
The first length values pointed to by ptr must be properly initialized values of type T.
capacity must be the capacity with which the memory pointed to by ptr was allocated.
The allocated size in bytes must be no larger than isize::MAX.
Nothing else may use ptr after calling Vec::from_parts.
